notes: FIRST PocketRoofline measurement on smartphone-class silicon (iPhone 13 / A15). Radios fully off (airplane mode, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth disabled), unplugged, app in foreground, single session run back-to-back SISO -> LISO -> SILO with one unrecorded warmup and ~3 s between repeats. PROTOCOL DEVIATION, recorded per METHODOLOGY 5: the device began at thermalState 'fair', not 'nominal' (the 10-minute ambient cooldown was not achieved before the session), and never returned to nominal. These are therefore warm-start figures. They are published as measured; the cold-start protocol run is a separate future session and will not overwrite this one. HEADLINE RESULT. Sustained generation (1024 tokens per repeat) throttles the A15: decode falls monotonically 40.53 -> 30.93 t/s across the five repeats, -23.7%, with a perfect rank-trend (Spearman rho = -1.00). Prefill falls in step, -23.9%. The device is in 'serious' thermal state throughout and does not recover within the session. The mean of this regime (36.48 t/s) is NOT a steady-state figure and must not be quoted as one: the series is non-stationary by construction. Report instead the sustained-load curve and the peak-vs-sustained gap - peak decode measured this session (42.80 t/s in SISO) overstates the fifth-repeat sustained figure (30.93 t/s) by 38%. This is the phone-specific behaviour that plugged-in desktop and single-board platforms cannot exhibit.
